title: Photo Gallery for Cloud Photos
summary: Third party app to view your Cloud Photos in a cloud photo gallery and on TV
description:
Important:
- The app requires an Apple ID
- This app is a third-party tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.
- The app transfers data directly between your device and Apple servers.
- We do not store, see, or have access to your username, password, or private photos.
- Your login and data stay between you and Apple’s servers.
- Apple and iCloud are trademarks of Apple Inc.

View photos from your Apple iCloud account in a cloud photo gallery and on TV.
Easily enjoy your Cloud photos and memories on the big screen! This app turns your TV into a photo gallery where you can browse and relive your favorite moments stored in the Cloud.

Whether your pictures are on Phone, Pad, or Computer, the app seamlessly connects to your Cloud storage and brings them to life on your TV — no cables, no hassle.

Perfect for photo slideshows, events, or just enjoying your photos at home.

Features:
- Browse photos and albums from your Apple Cloud account
- Fast and simple photo gallery on Android
- Big-screen friendly mode for TVs
- Full-screen photo viewer
- Smooth scrolling and clean design

Turn your TV into the ultimate Cloud Photo Gallery. With smooth photo sync from all your devices, you can finally enjoy your pictures the way they were meant to be seen — big, bright, and together with family and friends.
